ai_summary: Aaron Industries Limited reported exceptionally strong Q1FY27 financial performance, with revenue growing 27% and Profit After Tax surging by 142% year-on-year, driven by improved operating efficiencies. The company is focused on increasing capacity utilization and sees promising early traction for its premium EVOQ360 home lift product, which contributed 5-7% of Q1 revenue and boasts unique features. While international OEM engagement and expansion in certain global markets are progressing slowly due to external factors, management has clarified the internal consumption model for its steel polishing division, which appeared as a loss in segmental results, maintaining a positive outlook.
